title: Rooms Revocations Put — payload
description: An administrator of a room delivers the room's signed RevocationList to its host, which refuses every withdrawn credential from the moment it accepts the list.

presentation.description: Must confer the `admin` action at this room's scope, verified against the list the host already holds — not against the list being delivered. The list's authority is the room's signature on it; the presentation decides only who may make a host process one.

list.description: The room's signed, cumulative list. A host accepts it only under the rules of `RevocationList`: the room's own key, a higher sequence, and every live entry of the list it holds still present.

Response.title: Rooms Revocations Put — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/revocations/put. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/revocations/put/0.1#response. The list the host now holds and enforces, and the moment from which it does.

head.description: The list the host holds after this request. Equal to the delivered list's head when it was accepted or was a repeat.

inForceAt.description: When the host began refusing what the list withdraws. On a repeat, when it began refusing it the first time.
